leadText:
Old Man Obee (Japanese: アオバ Aoba) is a character of the day who appeared in Grass Hysteria!.

Along with several assistants, Old Man Obee is in charge of guarding the Forbidden Forest from intruders. When , and Max approached him to explain that had been carried by a inside, Obee debated as to whether or not to allow them inside the forest. Ignoring him, Ash and went inside. Obee explained to Brock and Max that the Forbidden Forest used to be overrun by Pokémon Trainers, and it was closed to the public because of that.

Despite this, Obee agreed that May needed to be rescued, and opened the gate temporarily to allow her rescue. Once the operation had been complete, Obee apologized to the Pokémon inside, saying he hoped that they would forgive him.
